import numpy as np
core=[np.ones_like(t),v,x,x**2,x**3,v*np.abs(v)]
res=[]
for w in np.linspace(0.1,1.5,281):
    for extra in ['cos','cos+sin','cos+xt','cos+xcos','cos+xt+xcos+xsin']:
        if extra=='cos': ex=[np.cos(w*t)]
        elif extra=='cos+sin': ex=[np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t)]
        elif extra=='cos+xt': ex=[np.cos(w*t),x*t]
        elif extra=='cos+xcos': ex=[np.cos(w*t),x*np.cos(w*t)]
        else: ex=[np.cos(w*t),x*t,x*np.cos(w*t),x*np.sin(w*t)]
        B=np.column_stack(core+ex)
        cc,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)
        res.append((np.mean((dv_dt-B@cc)**2)/np.var(dv_dt),w,extra,cc))
res.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
for r_ in res[:6]: print('%.3e'%r_[0],round(r_[1],3),r_[2],r_[3].round(3))
best=[r_ for r_ in res if r_[2]=='cos'][0]; print('cos only',best[0],best[1],best[3].round(3))
